description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeavePeriodServiceTrait' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Traits\Service'. It provides a method to retrieve the 'LeavePeriodService' instance from a dependency container, utilizing the 'ServiceContainerTrait'. The trait is used to facilitate access to leave period services within the OrangeHRM application, specifically for the leave module.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeavePeriodService obtained from the service container.
